question.text: The parameters of the unit cell of a substance are <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>90</mn><mo>°</mo><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>β</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>120</mn><mo>°</mo><mi>γ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>90</mn><mo>°</mo><mo>.</mo></math> The crystal system of the substance is :

solution.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">b</mi><mo>≠</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>γ</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>90</mn><mo>°</mo><mo>≠</mo><mi>β</mi></math> are parameters of monoclinic unit cell.
